dedupe_keys.name: curated l space representations of 61 east asian metro networks

description: This dataset gives L-space graph representations of 61 metro networks in East Asia as one JSON file per city, from Beijing, Busan and Changchun to Tokyo and Taipei. The networks were built from local non-English open data, not GTFS feeds and harmonised into one topological format: ktdb.go.kr for Seoul, Busan, Daegu and Incheon; tdx.transportdata.tw for Taipei, Taoyuan, Taichung and Kaohsiung; odpt.org for Tokyo, Yokohama, Kyoto, Kobe, Sapporo, Sendai and Fukuoka; and the Chinese map provider Amap for the other 47 systems. It was published by Oded Cats and Hanyu Cheng at TU Delft. Coverage is 61 cities in mainland China, Japan, South Korea and Taiwan. Access: free download from 4TU.ResearchData under CC0 (November 2025). Caveats: the graphs are topological only, and exact station names follow local languages and conventions. It supports network science and robustness analysis of metro systems, such as targeted and random station failure and cascading disruption studies, and complements the Chinese public transport network dataset and the Japanese railway data catalogued here.
name: Curated L-space representations of 61 East Asian metro networks
